summary: Codex CLI has no per-call model-request identity, so DelegationSigningProxy dedups Responses on the content fingerprint, which can wrong-merge two distinct same-content calls within one stage/attempt.
probe_method: Schema-integrity probe. The shipped native codex binary emits `struct ModelProviderInfo with <N> elements` (a Rust Debug impl string) — the authoritative structural signature of what a model-provider config can carry. The probe asserts N equals the audited baseline (model_provider_info_elements). This is exact and zero-false-positive: if Codex grows a field that could carry per-call identity, N changes and the probe fails, forcing a manual behavioral re-audit. Field-name enumeration from the binary is deliberately NOT asserted on: the names live as contiguous string-table internings (partial, with false neighbors), so a named-substring search both misses unnamed fields and false-positives on unrelated strings — which is why the prior idempotency-key substring probe was rejected. The audited field set (no per-call header; http_headers is a RawMcpServerConfig / MCP-server field, not a ModelProviderInfo field) is recorded in docs/KNOWN_BLOCKERS.md as a manual audit result, not an automated signal.
behavioral_probe: Not automated. Proving a field varies per call requires the real Codex binary, a mock OpenAI Responses upstream, and a delegation credential to drive two distinct calls through DelegationSigningProxy and diff the per-call headers it receives. That harness is not available in generic CI. Therefore any change to model_provider_info_elements MUST trigger this behavioral audit manually before KB-001 is touched. The dedicated CI job (OPENMONTAGE_CODEX_PROBE_STRICT=1) makes the static schema probe fail-not-skip, so a schema change in a pinned bump cannot pass unnoticed; the behavioral audit remains a gated human step.
unblock_condition: Codex model-provider config or the model request carries a value that varies per call (per-call header interpolation, or a stable per-call Idempotency-Key on the Responses request), AND a behavioral probe confirms it varies per call across two distinct same-stage calls. When model_provider_info_elements changes, run the behavioral probe; only then remove the content_fingerprint fallback in openmontage/delegation_proxy.py and close KB-001.

external_tracker.next_action: File an issue requesting per-call model-request identity (per-call header interpolation, or a stable per-call Idempotency-Key on the Responses request) before 2026-11-07, then set external_tracker.status=FILED and external_tracker.filed_issue to the issue URL both here and in docs/KNOWN_BLOCKERS.md.
